Логическая модель данных объединяет традиционные POS-данные с RFID-трекингом через идентификатор клиента, создавая целостный профиль поведения: демографические данные, координаты перемещения, скорость, время в зонах, связанные с фактами покупок. Chile purchased warships, prompting Argentina to expand its navy, leading to suggestions for mutual armament limitation. Chile hinted at British intervention; Minister Lowther communicated this to Minister Barrington in Buenos Aires, who proposed disarmament including canceling Argentine ironclad orders. Amgen announced that its cholesterol-lowering drug Repatha prevented heart disease death, heart attack, and stroke in a 12,000-patient trial. Analysts say the results could help the drug reach a broader market. Repatha, a PCSK9 inhibitor available since 2015, generated $2.2 billion in global sales in 2024, up 36% from the previous year. Existing data show it reduces heart attack and stroke risks in patients with existing heart problems by lowering LDL-C cholesterol. An analyst noted that current market penetration remains low, suggesting opportunity lies in increasing treatment urgency rather than expanding the patient pool.

This study investigates first-phase left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF-1), an echocardiographic index measuring early systolic function, as a tool for assessing coronary artery stenosis severity and myocardial recovery after percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI). Researchers enrolled 207 patients undergoing coronary angiography between June 2021 and June 2023, categorizing them by stenosis severity: mild (<50%), moderate (50-70%), and severe (≥70%). Results showed LVEF-1 decreased significantly with increasing stenosis severity and correlated negatively with Gensini scores (r=-0.694). LVEF-1 demonstrated superior diagnostic value compared to traditional parameters, with cutoff values of 27.9% and 26.9% predicting moderate and severe stenosis respectively. Among 82 patients undergoing PCI, LVEF-1 increased post-procedure, with greater improvement associated with higher Gensini scores and larger stent diameters. The study concludes LVEF-1 is a sensitive, clinically practical marker for detecting early cardiac dysfunction in coronary heart disease and evaluating post-PCI recovery.

NXP Semiconductors shares fell 5% after China's warning against US trade threats reduced hopes for early approval of Qualcomm's $44 billion acquisition. The deal, announced in October 2016, has eight of nine required regulatory approvals, with China pending. Qualcomm lawyers' planned meeting with Chinese antitrust regulators was put on hold.

This document summarizes clinical trial results for COVID-19 vaccines BNT162b2 and BNT162b2SA. Both vaccines produced immune responses against COVID-19, with BNT162b2 booster doses generating responses comparable to initial doses against the original strain, and BNT162b2SA generating comparable responses against the Beta variant. Common side effects included temporary lymphocyte drops (resolving within 6-8 days), injection site reactions (pain, redness, swelling), and systemic events (tiredness, headache, fever, chills, muscle pain). Most reactions were mild to moderate. Serious medical problems were rare (less than 1% of participants), with researchers generally not attributing them to the vaccines. No deaths were attributed to the vaccines. The 30 µg dose of BNT162b2 was selected for Phase 2/3 trials based on tolerability.

Peter Drucker, who predicted outsourcing and the rise of knowledge society, may have inspired the Modi government's moves toward an "ownership society." The concept originated from Drucker's privatisation ideas adopted by British politician David Howell in 1969, later expanded to mean individual freedom from government control. While India remains far from a true ownership society due to pervasive state control, subsidies, and government interference in business, the Modi government since 2014 has implemented reforms to reduce state's role: banking reforms including insolvency laws and bank consolidation; planned abolition of LPG and kerosene subsidies for non-poor households; and UDAY for state electricity boards. True ownership society requires ending government handouts and mass privatisation.

The TPS7H500x-SP series are radiation-hardness-assured current mode PWM controllers for space-grade DC-DC converters, supporting switching frequencies up to 2 MHz. The TPS7H5001-SP, TPS7H5002-SP, and TPS7H5003-SP feature programmable dead times (TDSP and TDPS) via resistors from PS and SP pins to AVSS, with 10 kΩ minimum and 300 kΩ maximum values; floating pins yield 8 ns minimum dead time. Leading edge blank time is fixed at 50 ns for TPS7H5003-SP but programmable via LEB pin resistor for other devices. Pulse skipping mode activates when COMP pin voltage is below 0.3 V and previous duty cycle was under 25%, preventing inductor current runaway. Maximum duty cycle is configurable via DCL pin: TPS7H5004-SP supports only 50% (DCL to AVSS), while other devices offer 50% (AVSS), 75% (floating), or 100% (VLDO). The CS_ILIM pin handles current sensing and overcurrent protection with 1.05 V threshold, triggering hiccup mode when exceeded. Hiccup mode involves cycle-by-cycle limiting until CHICC reaches 0.6 V, then switching stops until HICC discharges to 0.3 V. External fault protection via FAULT pin shuts down the controller above 0.6 V for 0.4–1.4 µs, with restart after ~15 clock cycles delay. Slope compensation prevents subharmonic oscillation above 50% duty cycle, set via RSC resistor. Thermal shutdown occurs at 175°C with restart at 160°C.

A backtest of the Santa Claus Rally in NIFTY 50 from 2008 to present found an average gain per trade of 1.2%, a 71% win ratio, a profit factor of 6, and a maximum drawdown of 7%. The strategy involved going long at the close of the second Friday in December and exiting at the close of the first trading day of the new year. The Pittsburgh Steelers unveiled 1978 throwback jerseys to commemorate the 40th anniversaries of their Super Bowl XIII and XIV victories, replacing the "bumblebee" uniforms for at least two seasons. Digital leaders prioritize transparency in data and decision-making, making data widely available across teams while implementing appropriate governance controls. They believe good ideas can come from anywhere and use measurement to learn, setting realistic, ambitious goals grounded in data that give teams flexibility and autonomy. Data-driven objectives align the organization vertically and horizontally, creating a shared "North Star" vision.

Digital laggards restrict data access on a "need-to-know" basis, often hoarding data as power. They favor business judgment over data-driven decisions, set aspirational goals insufficiently grounded in data, and focus on process adherence rather than objective success metrics. This creates misalignment between company priorities and strategy.

Organizations typically begin data transformation in one of four patterns: data novices (recognize need but lack culture/systems), insight ready (accepting culture but limited capabilities), tech enabled (have technology but discourage experimentation), or data reliant (over-rely on data, discouraging critical thinking).

On February 25, 2019, Amazon.com, Inc.'s Board of Directors elected Indra K. Nooyi as a director and appointed her to the Audit Committee. A study of 124 patients with borderline resectable or locally advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma found no association between circulating indole 3-acetate (3-IAA) levels and chemotherapy response or overall survival. This contrasts with prior research linking high 3-IAA to improved chemotherapy response in metastatic disease. The median pre-treatment 3-IAA concentration was 290 ng/mL. No significant differences were observed in 3-IAA levels by CT response, CA19-9 decline, surgical resection, or one-year survival status. In multivariable analysis, 3-IAA showed no significant association with survival (adjusted HR=0.87, 95% CI 0.68–1.12). The authors suggest the discrepancy may reflect differences between non-metastatic and metastatic disease populations, assay variations, or optimistic initial findings, and recommend validation studies in metastatic cohorts before clinical intervention trials.

A Michigan family is seeking legal action after their five-year-old son with asthma alleged that two teachers at Highview Elementary School repeatedly taped his mouth shut and threw out his lunch, with one incident reported on March 26. Researchers from McGill University and the University of Toronto have developed a new theoretical model reframing gaslighting as a learning process based on prediction error minimization (PEM). Builder Eric Woodward is creating a pop-up public park on a vacant Fort Langley lot after cancelling development plans due to a dispute with the Township of Langley. This paper investigates transfer learning (TL) to address domain shift (DS) in neuroimaging, where differences in scanners, protocols, and subject populations cause models trained on one dataset to perform poorly on another. The authors use Simple Fully Connected Neural Networks (SFCNs) pre-trained on UK Biobank (UKB) data and fine-tuned on smaller target datasets (OASIS-3, ABIDE, IXI) for age and sex prediction from structural MRI scans.

Key findings show that: (1) features learned on UKB remain partially transferable across datasets despite DS, with performance dropping from 99.5% accuracy on UKB to 59-90% on target datasets; (2) features are task-specific—models pre-trained on the same task outperform those trained on different tasks; (3) the proposed TL method (fine-tuning classifier then full model) significantly outperforms elastic net regression and training from scratch, with age prediction MAE approximately halved; (4) performance gains stem from actual feature reuse, not merely weight scaling; (5) TL achieves strong results even with small training sets (50+ samples), though very small datasets may require classifier-only fine-tuning to avoid overfitting; and (6) TL accelerates convergence. The UKB may serve as an "ImageNet for neuroimaging," though challenges remain for cross-task transfer and disease prediction.

Teuvo Teravainen discusses staying calm during games, his family's involvement in sports, and his experience playing with older players despite his small size. Antoine Vermette expresses excitement about playoff opportunities, emphasizes bringing one's best game, and notes the importance of confidence and perseverance through adversity. This study develops an AI model to classify citation intents in Turkish academic texts, addressing a gap in Turkish scholarly NLP. The authors created the first large-scale Turkish dataset for citation intent classification, containing 2,650 annotated examples from Computer Science articles. They benchmarked modern LLMs (GPT-4o, Gemini) using In-Context Learning, then advanced to automated prompt optimization with DSPy, achieving 86.5% accuracy. Finally, they developed a stacked ensemble meta-model using XGBoost that reached 91.3% accuracy. The research highlights challenges including Turkish's agglutinative morphology, class imbalance favoring the Background category, and difficulty distinguishing semantically close classes like Support and Differ. Future directions include addressing class imbalance through hierarchical classifiers, synthetic data generation, and incorporating broader contextual features.

On April 27, 2018, Amazon.com, Inc. entered into an amended and restated credit agreement increasing its unsecured revolving credit facility from $3.0 billion to $7.0 billion, extending the term to April 27, 2021, with Bank of America, N.A. as administrative agent. A hockey team discusses preparing for a potential Stanley Cup Finals clinching game, emphasizing mental readiness, the difficulty of closing out a series, and staying focused despite emotions. Prof. Ross Levine's research, published by NBER, demonstrates that easier borrowing conditions lead businesses to invest more in pollution-reduction projects. The study found that increased credit availability and lower interest rates make environmental loans more accessible and improve returns on green investments. Using the fracking boom as a natural experiment, researchers examined banks that received deposit windfalls from mineral lease payments in shale areas and found that non-fracking counties with these banks saw benzene levels drop 26 percent compared to average counties. Companies with lenders that received shale windfalls reduced toxic emissions more than similar companies without such lenders, according to EPA records. Levine noted he was surprised by these findings, having assumed green investments were driven mainly by regulatory requirements. The research does not assess fracking's own environmental impacts but uses it to isolate credit's effects on environmental performance.

Ryan Malone, a 37-year-old 2010 Olympic silver medalist, signed a 25-game tryout with the Iowa Wild (AHL) to maintain eligibility for the 2018 U.S. Olympic men's hockey team, which will lack active NHL players. David Ellison, backed by his father Larry Ellison, acquired Paramount earlier this year and is widely expected to bid for Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD), though he refused to discuss plans at a Bloomberg event. A Paramount-WBD merger has industrial logic: combining streaming services, studios, sports rights, and back-office functions could create a viable challenger to Netflix, Disney, and Amazon. Larry Ellison's wealth and Trump administration connections may ease financing and antitrust concerns. WBD CEO David Zaslav may resist selling, but his previous efforts to boost stock have failed. If completed, the deal would continue Hollywood's consolidation trend, reducing major streaming competitors from six to fewer players.

Edit distance, originating in the 1960s for string comparison and later extended to trees and Reeb graphs, is defined by admissible edits with associated costs, with distance measured by minimal total transformation cost. The interleaving distance, introduced in 2009, is a foundational metric in topological data analysis for comparing persistence modules over posets. This work establishes that the interleaving distance on finitely presented R^d-persistence modules can be realized as an edit distance through suitable specifications of objects and edits. The key insight connects Galois connections to interleaving distance via free presentations of persistence modules, providing an order-theoretic alternative to the combinatorial bottleneck-interleaving isometry viewpoint. Two categories of constructible R^d-persistence modules are introduced—JS^d using finite join-semilattices and (1D)^d using finite d-grids—with associated edit distances d^{JS^d}_{Ed} and d^{(1D)^d}_{Ed}. The main result proves d_I(M,N) = d^E_{Ed}(M,N) for E ∈ {JS^d, (1D)^d}, achieved by showing d_I ≤ d^{JS^d}_{Ed} ≤ d^{(1D)^d}_{Ed} ≤ d_I. This isometry enables characterization of interleaving-stable invariants in terms of edit-stable invariants and facilitates exploration of stable invariants for multi-parameter persistent homology.

A Calgary mother's car was stolen containing her 12-year-old son Caden's hockey gear, worth four times the vehicle's value. Shauna Sinfield, who has multiple sclerosis and lives on a fixed income, faces replacing approximately $1,500-$2,000 in equipment for her son's eighth hockey season. Police say recovery is unlikely as thieves likely pawned the gear. A GoFundMe has raised $685 toward a $3,000 goal.

The TPS7H500x-SP series are radiation-hardness-assured current mode PWM controllers for space-grade DC-DC converters, supporting topologies including buck, flyback, forward, active-clamp forward, push-pull, and full-bridge with switching frequencies up to 2 MHz. The CS_ILIM pin handles transformer primary-side current sensing for PWM generation and current limit configuration, with a 1.05 V threshold triggering hiccup mode. Hiccup mode involves cycle-by-cycle current limiting until CHICC reaches 0.6 V, then switching stops until HICC discharges to 0.3 V and soft-start resumes. The FAULT pin enables external protection with 0.6 V threshold and 0.4–1.4 µs minimum pulse width. Slope compensation via RSC prevents subharmonic oscillation above 50% duty cycle. Thermal shutdown activates at 175°C with restart at 160°C. A synchronous push-pull converter design example demonstrates component selection including 205 kΩ RT for 500 kHz operation, 25 ns dead time, 50 ns leading edge blank time, 33 nF soft-start capacitor, 2.5:1 transformer turns ratio, and GaN FETs rated at 170 V primary and 80 V secondary. Layout guidelines emphasize minimizing noise coupling, separating analog and power grounds, and placing bypass capacitors close to the controller.

A hockey player expressed disappointment after a playoff loss, citing a mediocre second period that cost the team despite strong play in the third period. He noted both goaltenders played well, emphasized the need for consistent sixty-minute efforts, and expressed confidence playing at home for the next game. A fourth-grade student in Grand Haven, Michigan, is selling handmade "stretchy straw fidgeters" to help pay off school lunch debts after learning some classmates receive only cheese sandwiches when they owe money. Lexi Bergeron started by making $11 in her first week selling fidget strings for $1 each. Her mother created a GoFundMe initially seeking $188 for Ferry Elementary's debt, but expanded the goal to $2,200 by December's end to cover all lunch debts in the district.

This article advocates for a sociocultural perspective on foreign language education policy in Asian countries where English is compulsory, focusing on the divergence between policy intentions and outcomes. It examines how mandated communicative language teaching approaches and CEFR-based proficiency targets often fail to account for contextual realities, resulting in socio-economic inequality in achievement. The analysis of Malaysia and Thailand reveals that urban-rural divides, strong national language identities, unrealistic teacher proficiency expectations, and classroom conditions such as large mixed-ability classes and standardized testing pressures lead teachers to abandon prescribed methods. The article concludes that effective policy requires alignment with sociolinguistic, sociocultural, and socio-educational realities rather than centralized, context-disconnected mandates.

The passage describes research on Plasmodium vivax malaria relapse mechanisms, focusing on the "exponential clock" mathematical model where hypnozoites activate independently at a constant rate. The study analyzes data from a 1993–1995 SPf66 vaccine trial involving 1,344 Thai children aged 2–15 years followed daily for 21 months. Key findings include: estimated hypnozoite half-life of 118 days; mean sporozoite batch size of 6.9 per infectious bite; approximately 75% of observed vivax infections were relapses rather than primary infections; higher vivax rates following P. falciparum infections treated with artesunate monotherapy suggest external triggering; and mefloquine's one-month post-treatment prophylactic effect eliminates emerging relapses. The model incorporates stochastic variation in mosquito bite timing, sporozoite numbers, and sporozoite fate, plus age-dependent anti-disease immunity. Results demonstrate the model can capture complex temporal infection patterns across childhood age groups, with up to 13 symptomatic vivax episodes per child recorded.

Researchers have identified natural bacteria from grape plants that can degrade guaiacol, a key compound causing smoke taint in wine after wildfire exposure. Two bacterial strains found on chardonnay and cabernet sauvignon leaves nearly eliminated guaiacol within 96 hours in lab conditions. The researchers identified the specific gene responsible for this degradation. However, the bacteria did not grow on other smoky compounds, indicating additional bacterial types will be needed to address other contributors to smoke taint. Current mitigation methods like activated charcoal filtering can remove desirable wine components, making this microbial approach potentially more selective. The wine industry faces increasing challenges from prolonged wildfire seasons, with California and Oregon winemakers losing over $3 billion in 2020 alone. Further research is needed to explore the grape plant microbiome's potential to consume other volatile phenols causing smoke taint.

The Department of Education is holding its first School Safety Conference at Okkodo High School this month to address drugs, violence, suicide, bullying, harassment, and sexual identity among over 30,000 public school students. The conference aims to provide strategies and workshops on safe school practices for approximately 400 support staff, with five focus areas: law enforcement impact, legal issues, positive school climate, reducing substance use, and crisis/mental health response. Drug and alcohol cases increased in 2015-2016 with 352 incidents, prompting a shift toward treatment rather than discipline, including group therapy to address root causes. The event begins June 26; contact 300-1623 for information.

The Czech National Bank may scrap its euro/crown cap at today's meeting after its weak-crown commitment ended last week, raising volatility hedging costs to nine-month highs. NVIDIA Corporation's Q3 fiscal year 2020 Form 10-Q filing reports financial results for the quarter ended October 27, 2019. Jack Wilshere held talks with West Ham United manager Manuel Pellegrini about a potential transfer after leaving Arsenal due to limited playing time under Unai Emery. While multiple clubs are interested, West Ham leads the race despite Fenerbahçe offering higher wages. Wilshere's family ties to London and desire to remain visible to England manager Gareth Southgate for international selection motivate staying in the Premier League. His future remains uncertain following the meeting.

The Education Department held the first round of negotiated rule-making talks on the One Big Beautiful Bill Act's changes to the student loan system, with discussions continuing despite a federal government shutdown. The most contentious issue was defining which postbaccalaureate programs qualify as "professional" for higher loan caps ($200,000 vs. $100,000). The department initially proposed limiting professional programs to 10 listed examples from the Higher Education Act, but after pushback offered a one-year expansion allowing programs designated as professional before July 4, 2025. No consensus was reached. Committee members also discussed repayment plans, with concerns raised about the complex transition process for existing borrowers to remain in Income-Based Repayment before it ends July 1, 2026. A study of 451,355 UK Biobank participants examined cardiovascular disease biomarkers and outcomes stratified by BMI and diabetes mellitus (DM) status. Among participants with DM, 10% had normal weight, 34% were overweight, and 55% were obese. In non-DM participants, overweight/obesity was associated with higher carotid intima-media thickness, arterial stiffness, and cardiac contractility index, and lower left ventricular ejection fraction; these relationships were diminished in the DM group. After 5.3 million person-years follow-up, cardiovascular mortality rose across BMI categories in both groups, but normal-weight DM participants had higher cardiovascular mortality than obese non-DM participants (incidence rate ratio 2.81 vs 1.84). Both obesity and DM were additively associated with adverse cardiovascular outcomes, though adiposity metrics correlated more strongly with cardiovascular biomarkers than diabetes-oriented metrics.

In *People v. Yuk Bui Yee* (1978), the defendant moved to sever 13 counts of extortion-related offenses across three separate incidents at different Chinese restaurants. The court analyzed whether joinder was proper under CPL 200.20(2)(b) or (2)(c), noting that severance is only permitted for (c) joinders. The court found the offenses joinable under paragraph (b) because proof of each would be admissible under the *Molineux* exceptions: the defendant used a distinctive modus operandi (speaking Mandarin, claiming gang affiliation, demanding money for "brothers") establishing identity; the prior acts showed intent for subsequent offenses; and while no single common scheme linked all three restaurant groups, the repetitive conduct supported joinder. The motion to sever was denied.

The speaker emphasizes playing patient, simple hockey by getting the puck deep, minimizing opponent speed through the neutral zone, and finding ways to get shots past goaltender Ward. They note the opponent's strong shot-blocking and collapsing defensive style similar to San Jose, requiring better execution to get pucks through to the net. They acknowledge their team could have played better in front of their own goaltender, who played well despite not playing for months, and hope to rebound from frustration in the next game.

This study examined cross-sectional and longitudinal associations between arterial stiffness (measured by brachial-ankle pulse wave velocity, baPWV) and kidney function in 67,060 Chinese adults. Cross-sectional analysis showed negative associations between estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) and baPWV. Longitudinal analysis of 12,324 participants revealed bidirectional associations: higher baPWV predicted chronic kidney disease (CKD) incidence, and lower eGFR predicted arterial stiffness risk. Cross-lagged panel analysis indicated kidney function decline preceded arterial stiffness changes. The study suggests a temporal relationship where decreased eGFR appears to come before increased arterial stiffness, though both conditions influence each other.

This case study examined long-term effects of spinal cord stimulation (SCS) for sensory feedback in one woman aged 60-65 with unilateral transtibial amputation. SCS leads were implanted near T12-L2 vertebral levels for 84 days, with stimulation delivered during prosthetic stance phase based on plantar pressure. Following multiple weeks of SCS use, EMG recordings showed reduced co-contractions between knee antagonist muscles (vastus lateralis and biceps femoris) and increased tensor fasciae latae activation, corresponding to increased pelvic obliquity range-of-motion and pelvic drop. These functional improvements in knee and hip stability during walking persisted even without stimulation, suggesting possible rehabilitative effects.

Bear Grylls has criticised schools for failing to adequately prepare children for adult life, arguing they should focus on empowering students rather than league table rankings. The survival expert and father-of-three believes success stems from determination rather than academic achievement, citing his own experience as a former Eton student who was "never very brilliant" but relied on persistence. Grylls, who passed SAS selection despite not being the "sportiest or cleverest," stated that "life rewards the persistent." He expressed gratitude for Eton's progressive approach but maintained schools must do more to equip children for life's challenges. Grylls also commented that he hopes Donald Trump is "too busy" to join him on an adventure, noting that while Trump is "tenacious," he "likes to be king" whereas survival requires humility. He contrasted this with Barack Obama, who joined him in 2015 and called it "one of the best days of his presidency."

North Texas experienced hail from thunderstorms last weekend, with only four tornadoes reported this season compared to the April average of seven. Oklahoma has recorded zero tornadoes in 2018, the latest into a season without one since April 26, 1962. Kansas also has zero tornadoes so far. Despite the slow start, tornado activity may increase significantly in May for both states, as April and May typically see the most tornadoes in North Texas.

This study introduces SCIseg, an open-source deep learning method for automatic segmentation of the spinal cord and T2-weighted hyperintense lesions in traumatic spinal cord injury (SCI) MRI images. The model was trained on 196 scans from 191 patients across three sites using a three-phase training protocol with active learning, and evaluated on independent test sets. SCIseg achieved Dice scores of 0.90-0.94 for spinal cord segmentation and 0.48-0.76 for lesion segmentation, outperforming existing methods. The model generalizes across different scanners, treatment strategies, lesion etiologies, and also works for degenerative cervical myelopathy. Quantitative MRI biomarkers derived from SCIseg predictions showed statistically significant correlations with clinical scores and no significant difference compared to manual annotations.

Russian Prime Minister Dmitry Medvedev reported to President Vladimir Putin on April 17 that the Russian economy is on a positive development path, with industrial output growing 1.3 percent and agricultural output growing 5 percent in the previous year. Medvedev noted that agricultural machine-building has also expanded, with production of machinery, harvesters, and tractors rising 60 percent.

While Army & Air Force Exchange Service shopping privileges are restricted to military personnel and families, anyone—including visitors, contractors, and DoD civilians—can dine at Exchange restaurants or purchase grab-and-go items from Express locations for on-installation consumption, per Army Regulation 215-8/Air Force Instruction 34-211 (I). The Exchange operates over 1,600 restaurants and 300-plus Express locations worldwide. Those seeking full Exchange benefits should contact their local Exchange manager.

A sports team remains calm and focused heading into a Sunday game, having successfully refocused after previous matches. They plan to maintain their game plan of building momentum throughout the series and wearing opponents down, regardless of score. Players emphasize mental toughness, routine consistency, and collective effort, drawing on experience from big games like Olympics and World Cup. They acknowledge facing adversity and need to start better after their opponent dominated early in the previous game. The team praises their goalie's performance in limiting second opportunities and notes the special atmosphere of home games with passionate fans. They plan to continue being aggressive against dangerous opponents to force uncomfortable plays.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on July 25, 2019, announcing its second quarter 2019 financial results. The filing includes two exhibits: Exhibit 99.1 containing the press release with the financial results announcement, and Exhibit 99.2 providing information about non-GAAP financial measures. The report was signed by Brian T. Olsavsky, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer.

Athletes Unlimited (AU) is a player-driven professional women's sports league founded in 2020 by Jon Patricof and Jonathan Soros. The league features innovative elements including no team owners, weekly team drafts, individual leaderboards, single-location seasons, and player governance through Player Executive Committees. AU launched leagues in softball, volleyball, lacrosse, and basketball, with players receiving base pay, performance bonuses, and equity-like interests through a Profit Participation Plan. The organization operates as a public benefit corporation with a "Mission Equity" capital structure that caps investor returns and directs surplus to players. AU secured broadcast partnerships with major networks and raised $30 million in 2022, becoming the first women's sports league named to Fast Company's most innovative companies list. The league emphasizes athlete empowerment, professional treatment, social impact initiatives, and storytelling to build fan engagement.

This patent application describes methods, systems, and devices for allocating wireless resources in multiple BSSID networks using trigger-based random access. An access point (AP) associated with a transmitted BSSID (Tx BSSID) or non-transmitted BSSID (non-Tx BSSID) allocates random access resources to stations using association identifier (AID) values based on group AID mapping in a traffic indication map (TIM) element's partial virtual bitmap. The AP transmits trigger frames containing AID values to identify target stations, specific BSSIDs, groups of BSSIDs, or all stations in the multiple BSSID set. Random resource units (RUs) are allocated by setting AID values to: zero for Tx BSSID stations, a BSSID index for non-Tx BSSID stations, or 2045 for unassociated stations. The transmitter address in trigger frames is set to the Tx BSSID's MAC address or the non-Tx BSSID's BSSID index accordingly. Management frames include multiple BSSID elements indicating BSSID indices and random access parameter set (RAPS) elements with OFDMA contention window values for each AP.

Grupo Supervielle S.A. (SUPV) presented at Latin Securities Argentina in London, with a slideshow published for the event. The presentation includes a chart showing data from September 29 to October 3, 2025, with values ranging from 4.61 to 5.53. The document also contains unrelated article titles about dividends, retirement portfolios, market bubbles, Bitcoin, Novo Nordisk, and Alphabet's AI opportunities.

President Kennedy delivered a speech at Amherst College honoring Robert Frost, emphasizing the responsibility of educated citizens to serve public interest. He noted that private colleges draw heavily from wealthy families while inherited poverty persists, and that graduates must use their advantages to address national challenges including unemployment, international relations, and racial harmony. Kennedy praised Frost as both artist and American, arguing that art and poetry serve essential functions in democracy by questioning power, revealing truth, and preventing arrogance. He called for a future America that balances strength with moral restraint, wealth with wisdom, and rewards artistic achievement equally with business success, while protecting cultural heritage and expanding opportunities for all citizens.

The nonprofit "Look Good … Feel Better" will hold a free event on May 8 at Dignity Health Sierra Nevada Memorial Hospital Diagnostic Imaging, where beauty professionals will volunteer to help women in active cancer treatment manage appearance-related side effects through skincare, makeup techniques, and hair loss coping strategies. Registration is available by calling 1-800-227-2345; more information is at lookgoodfeelbetter.org.

The CAT offense is a basketball strategy using a 2-1-2 spread alignment designed to counter traps and double teams, with the post position as its key element. It features four main components: baseline back cuts when the ball goes to the middle, post roll action where the post player rolls to the basket on corner passes, an opposite corner rule for skip passes when trapped, and limited dribble penetration to escape pressure.

Tight ends remain crucial in modern football despite offensive trends favoring spread formations and high-volume passing. They create matchup problems for defenses due to their combination of size, strength, and athleticism. The position involves both route running and blocking responsibilities, with tight ends typically running short-to-medium routes and blocking defensive linemen and linebackers. The name derives from early football terminology when wide receivers were called "ends"; those lining up closer to the formation became "tight ends." Alternative names include TE and H-back. Required skills include strong hands, athleticism, speed, blocking, route running, and physicality, with ideal body types ranging from 6'3"-6'8" and 240-270 pounds. Notable tight ends include Tony Gonzalez, Rob Gronkowski, Antonio Gates, and Shannon Sharpe. The position's versatility allows offenses to run diverse schemes, combining receiving ability with blocking strength.

Guangdong Province is experiencing China's largest chikungunya outbreak on record, with over 4,000 confirmed cases since late July, primarily concentrated in Shunde District. The mosquito-borne disease, transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, causes fever and severe joint pain but does not spread person-to-person. Local authorities have launched province-wide efforts to eliminate standing water and reduce mosquito breeding. Climate change, urbanization, and global travel are cited as factors expanding mosquito-borne disease threats. The World Health Organization has issued new clinical guidelines and strengthened its Global Arbovirus Initiative to address these challenges. There is no specific antiviral treatment or licensed vaccine for chikungunya; care focuses on symptom relief.

CTC-Pak officials urged prioritizing health over business on World No Tobacco Day, stating tobacco causes 16% of non-communicable disease deaths in Pakistan, with cardiovascular diseases being the highest at 19% of total deaths. They criticized the government for delaying implementation of 85% pictorial health warnings on cigarette packs since 2015 and compromising on tobacco taxes by maintaining a third tier benefiting the industry. The coalition, comprising over 250 civil society organizations, called for stricter enforcement of tobacco control laws, higher taxes, and fulfillment of Pakistan's 2004 Framework Convention on Tobacco Control obligations to protect public health.

Researchers developed a minorization-maximization (MM) algorithm for maximum likelihood and restricted maximum likelihood estimation in multivariate variance components linear mixed models using Julia, addressing computational limitations of existing methods that could only handle at most two phenotypes with multiple variance components or multiple phenotypes with two variance components. Applying this method to PsychENCODE dataset, they modeled gene isoforms jointly, partitioning genetic variance among cis- and trans-SNPs. Findings showed cis-SNPs have sparse but large effects on expression, while trans-SNPs have small individual but large collective effects. Isoform-level analyses revealed more genetic signals than gene-level analyses, with some isoform-specific signals associated with psychiatric disorder risk, suggesting isoform-resolution analyses can uncover novel disease genes.

This email newsletter from True Orange dated November 13, 2000, covers Texas Longhorns athletics recruiting and news. The main recruiting weekend is December 15-17, with 19 football commits already secured and 10 prospects still considering Texas, including top defensive tackle Tommie Harris. Football bowl possibilities include the Cotton, Holiday, or Alamo Bowl if Texas beats Texas A&M. The women's basketball team advanced to the Preseason WNIT semifinals after beating Tulane 71-47. The newsletter also announces signing classes for baseball (12 players), women's basketball (4 players including top national recruit Heather Schreiber), men's basketball (T.J. Ford and Chris Wright), volleyball (2 players), softball (6 players including national top recruit Cat Osterman), and golf (Charlie Santaularia). The author criticizes the athletic department for poor treatment of fans regarding early kickoff times and untelevised road games.

The authors introduce Solvent Data-Driven Embeddings (SoDaDE), a new data-driven fingerprint for solvents created by training a transformer model on a small solvent property dataset with data augmentation. The model outperforms previous representations on the Catechol Benchmark, achieving MSE of 0.0026 (full data) and 0.0044 (single solvent) compared to 0.0100 for the next best method. The approach combines text tokens, ChemBERTa fingerprints, and scalar values in shuffled sequences with masking during training. Results show strong performance on solvent property prediction and demonstrate that effective fingerprints can be created from small datasets without requiring fine-tuning.

This MIT OpenCourseWare lecture by Alan V. Oppenheim covers discrete-time systems, building on previous concepts of linearity and shift invariance. The lecture introduces two additional constraints: stability and causality. For linear shift-invariant systems, stability requires the unit sample response to be absolutely summable, while causality requires the unit sample response to be zero for n < 0. The lecture then examines linear constant-coefficient difference equations, showing that they require boundary conditions to uniquely specify a system, and demonstrates how different conditions yield causal or non-causal solutions. Finally, the lecture introduces frequency response as an alternative to convolution sum representation, explaining that complex exponentials are eigenfunctions of linear shift-invariant systems. The frequency response H(e^jω) is derived from the unit sample response and is periodic with period 2π, with magnitude representing amplitude change and phase representing phase shift for sinusoidal inputs.

GameStop will stock Nintendo Switch consoles at all 4,400+ U.S. stores starting August 15-16, with at least five units per location at the standard $300 price. This marks the first time since launch that all stores will have simultaneous stock. Units are in-store only, not online. Other retailers like Target may also occasionally have Switch consoles available.

This MIT OpenCourseWare lecture by Jack Hare introduces radiation as a diagnostic tool for plasmas, covering radiation transport theory and the physics of radiation from moving charges.

The lecture begins by establishing that all objects emit electromagnetic radiation, with hotter objects producing higher energy photons. Plasmas span an enormous range from radio frequencies to gamma rays, requiring different conceptual frameworks: wave treatments for longer wavelengths and ray treatments for shorter wavelengths. Radiation serves dual purposes—it can cool plasmas (significant in fusion energy contexts) but also provides diagnostic information about plasma conditions.

The core of the lecture presents radiation transport theory. The fundamental equation states that the change in spectral radiance I along a path s equals emissivity j minus opacity α times I: dI/ds = j - αI. This describes how radiation is both emitted and absorbed as it travels through plasma. Optical depth τ, defined as the integral of opacity along the path, allows rewriting this as dI/dτ = j/α - I. The general solution shows that observed intensity equals initial intensity attenuated by absorption plus integrated emission along the path, with earlier emissions experiencing more absorption.

Two important limits emerge: optically thin (τ << 1), where radiation streams through with minimal absorption, and optically thick (τ >> 1), where radiation reaches blackbody equilibrium. Kirchhoff's law connects these quantities: j/α equals the blackbody intensity, meaning high emission regions also have high absorption.

The lecture distinguishes optical depth effects from wave cutoff phenomena—cutoffs involve reflection and evanescent decay (no oscillation), while optical depth involves gradual absorption with continued wave oscillation.

Finally, the lecture examines why accelerated charges radiate. Using Poynting vector analysis, Hare shows that constant velocity charges merely transport their fields (Poynting flux ~ 1/r³), while accelerated charges produce propagating radiation (Poynting flux ~ 1/r²). The full Lienard-Wiechert solution for radiation from a moving charge contains near-field (~1/r²) and far-field (~1/r) terms, with only the far-field representing observable radiation. Calculating actual plasma radiation requires solving particle equations of motion and integrating over velocity distributions—steps the lecture defers to future sessions.

A coach or player reflects on a recent loss in a Stanley Cup playoff series, noting strong transition play and puck movement in the first period but defensive mistakes that led to goals. The team played on its heels after falling behind and lost some offensive rhythm. Despite the loss, the speaker emphasizes the opportunity to play for the Stanley Cup with home ice advantage in a best-of-three series. The team plans to feed off home crowd energy. The opponent (Boston) is credited for playing smart defensively and shutting down their offense, with particular praise for their Vezina-nominated goaltender Tim Thomas and his unconventional style. The speaker acknowledges needing to get more pucks and bodies to the net, create screens, and fix offensive struggles. Confidence is expressed in their own goaltender, Roberto Luongo. Issues are raised about Thomas playing out of the blue paint, initiating contact, and interpretations of rules regarding crease access, which have been discussed with the NHL. References are made to specific mistakes in the previous game, including a broken stick and a puck put in their own net, with the team having moved on and analyzed areas for improvement. The ice conditions are noted as suboptimal but equal for both teams and expected to improve.

MMFP-Tableau is a bioinformatics platform developed at Children's Hospital of Philadelphia to integrate siloed clinical and research data for primary mitochondrial disease. The platform uses Alteryx to extract, clean, and model data from EPIC EMR, REDCap surveys, and Excel spreadsheets, then visualizes it in Tableau for clinician and researcher access. It integrates data from over 2,000 individuals, enabling cohort-level and individual patient queries, clinical trial eligibility screening, genotype-phenotype mapping, medication trend analysis, and risk factor delineation. The system improves upon manual chart review by providing real-time, automated data integration with role-based access controls. Limitations include inability to access some non-discretized EMR data, external institution data, and certain imaging systems. The platform is designed to be scalable and transferable to other rare diseases.

NVIDIA's Blackwell GPU architecture introduces ninth-generation NVENC with 5% quality improvements for AV1/HEVC, 4:2:2 encoding support, and AV1 UHQ mode for additional 5% gains. The RTX 5090 features three encoders and two decoders, enabling 50% faster export speeds. Blackwell includes sixth-generation NVDEC with 2x faster H.264 decoding and DisplayPort 2.1b support up to 80 Gbps.

Max-Q power efficiency improvements include advanced power gating with reduced state transition latencies, separate voltage rails for GPU cores and memory, and accelerated frequency switching 1000x faster than previous architectures. Deep sleep states are 10x faster to enter than Ada, enabling up to 50% power savings in workloads like small language model inference.

DLSS 4 introduces Multi Frame Generation, producing up to three additional frames per rendered frame using a 40% faster AI model with 30% less VRAM usage. Enhanced Flip Metering improves frame pacing. Transformer-based models replace CNNs for Super Resolution, Ray Reconstruction, and DLAA, delivering better temporal stability, reduced ghosting, and improved detail in motion.

Blackwell enables neural shaders through the Cooperative Vectors API, allowing Tensor Core access from any shader type. Features include RTX Neural Materials for film-quality assets, Neural Texture Compression providing 7:1 VRAM savings, Neural Radiance Cache for global illumination, RTX Skin for subsurface scattering, and RTX Neural Faces using generative AI for realistic facial rendering.

The architecture comprises GB202 (flagship, 92.2B transistors, 24,576 CUDA cores), GB203 (high-end, 45.6B transistors, 10,752 CUDA cores), and GB205 (performance, 31B transistors, 6,400 CUDA cores), powering the RTX 5090, 5080/5070 Ti, and 5070 respectively.

The Trump administration has postponed threatened 100% tariffs on pharmaceutical imports that were set to begin October 1. A White House official stated the administration will now begin preparing tariffs on companies that don't build U.S. infrastructure or make drug pricing agreements, with no new timeline provided. The delay suggests the tariff threats were aimed at pressuring pharmaceutical companies to invest domestically and lower prices.

The head and shoulders pattern is a technical analysis chart formation indicating potential trend reversals, consisting of three price rallies with the middle being highest. The standard pattern signals bearish reversal in uptrends, completed when price breaks below the neckline support. The inverse pattern signals bullish reversal in downtrends, completed when price breaks above neckline resistance. Thomas Bulkowski's research found a 93% success rate for the standard pattern across 431 samples, with an average 23% price drop. The inverse pattern showed strong reliability with 20-30% returns within 73 days. The Federal Reserve's 1995 study confirmed technical analysis generates statistically significant profits. However, the authors caution that Bulkowski's after-the-fact analysis and the difficulty of quantifying precise backtest rules warrant careful approach to this strategy.

House Of Fraser reported a rise in full-year pre-tax profits from £1.3 million to £3.4 million, with online sales up 16.1% and accounting for over a fifth of total sales. Overall revenues remained flat at £1.3 billion, while like-for-like sales rose 0.9%. The company warned that trading volatility has continued into 2017, with subdued February trading followed by improvement in March. Five under-performing brands will be discontinued this year. The finance chief acknowledged challenging retail conditions but credited the business model and new senior management. The company recently opened its first standalone shop in China in Nanjing.

Around 125 people participated in public sessions on September 1-2 to provide input for a masterplan for Newtongrange's centre, organized by LDA for Midlothian Council and Borders Railway Blueprint Partnership. Councillor Russell Imrie thanked participants and emphasized shared commitment to making Newtongrange thrive. The masterplan team will now develop designs for further community engagement later this year.

The Base Cross offense is difficult to stop for defenses unprepared against inside games and quick ball reversals. Two defensive strategies are presented: Basic NBA Show & Recover and All Out SOS Disruption.

Show & Recover involves the defender "showing" to block the screener's path, forcing the post high and wide, while weakside defenders pack in. This has three phases: showing (X2 steps out hard, X5 trails over), recovery (X5 plays O5 straight up, weakside helps), and final matchup (X1 applies ball pressure, X5 pushes O5 off block).

SOS Disruption traps the ball handler before post entry using a "Hi-Lo Switch"—defenders switch if the post goes baseline, don't switch if going over top. Phase 1 involves a sideline trap with X1 and X2, contact pivot switches, and helpside positioning. Phase 2 covers rotations when the ball leaves the trap. Phase 3 establishes final matchups with closeouts, post fronts, and box pressure to prevent ball reversal.

Calvin Alexander, a seventh grader from Caddo Middle Magnet, won the Northwest Louisiana regional spelling bee for the second consecutive year, spelling "nectarivorous." The competition on March 17 at LSUS involved 22 spellers from 28 regions over 20 rounds. Alexander defeated Rosetta Schultz of Ruston Junior High School, who missed "horotelic." He advances to the 2018 Scripps National Spelling Bee in Washington, D.C., May 29-31, with an expenses-paid trip and prizes including a 2018 U.S. Mint Proof Set, Britannica Online Premium subscription, and Merriam-Webster Unabridged Online subscription. Spellers studied from 2018 School Spelling Bee Study List and Spell It! materials; words after round 9 were not previously provided. The Scripps National Spelling Bee reaches approximately 11 million students globally to improve spelling, vocabulary, and English usage.

The OECD has warned of overheating in the Irish economy, citing sharply rising new mortgage loans and loans to small firms driven by construction activity. While Central Bank lending restrictions have reduced risky loans, the OECD suggested they may need extension to cool credit growth. New mortgage lending approved in April jumped 20% to €842 million year-on-year. The OECD raised the prospect of "another property bubble" if 13% annual house-price growth continues. The warning follows a Central Bank study finding nearly 8,000 pre-crash mortgages could default in a financial shock. The last OECD housing bubble warning was in June 2006, ignored by government then. NTMA chief Conor O'Kelly said Irish bond stability amid Italian market turmoil shows investors have "reclassified" Ireland closer to the euro-zone core. Italy's 10-year bond yield spiked to 3.44% amid election fears, while Ireland's remained around 1%. The OECD said Irish economic activity will stay robust near-term before easing, but the Government must improve its fiscal position to buffer against Brexit risks. European Commission officials also warned persistent housing supply shortages are fuelling price increases.

ExxonMobil sent a dozen traders and marketers to an oil trade show in Dongying, China this week to court independent refiners known as "teapots," marking a departure from the company's traditional one-on-one sales approach. The marketing blitz, led by global crude marketing manager Thomas Martenak, aims to make up for Exxon's late entry into China's independent refining market, which has grown to buy one-fifth of China's crude imports since receiving government licenses in 2015. Exxon faces established competition from BP, Shell, and major traders like Vitol and Trafigura in Dongying, China's largest refining center with 32 refineries. Martenak stated the push was driven by market opportunity rather than politics, despite ongoing U.S.-China trade tensions.

This paper introduces automatic detection of "hype"—promotional language used to exaggerate research significance—in biomedical texts. The authors define hype as hyperbolic or subjective language that glamorizes research, focusing on 11 "novelty" adjectives (e.g., groundbreaking, innovative) from a lexicon of 140 potentially promotional terms. They developed formal six-step annotation guidelines to classify adjectives as Hype or Not Hype based on value judgment, hyperbole, gratuitousness, amplification, coordination, and broader context. Three annotators applied these guidelines to 550 sentences from NIH grant abstracts, achieving improved agreement after discussion (Cohen's Kappa 0.94–0.98). The resulting dataset of 537 sentences showed 72% were hype, with groundbreaking, revolutionary, unparalleled, and unprecedented always deemed hype, while emerging and latest were most ambiguous.

Experiments framed hype detection as text classification, testing traditional methods (SVM with GLOVE embeddings performed best at 79.6% accuracy), fine-tuned language models (BERT reached 86.1%, surpassing human baseline of 82.4%), and large language models (GPT-4O-MINI matched human performance). Results indicate that formal guidelines enable reliable human annotation and that trained models show promise, though the task requires complex contextual understanding and domain knowledge. Limitations include subjectivity, limited scope to novelty adjectives and English biomedical texts, small dataset size, and computational constraints.

The DuBard School for Language Disorders at the University of Southern Mississippi received recognition from IMSLEC as one of four U.S. schools committed to student achievement through multisensory structured language education. The DuBard Association Method, accredited by IMSLEC since 1998, is used daily at the school to teach reading, speaking, and writing, and the school serves as the national training site for this method. Interim director Missy Schraeder stated the school works to implement the method with high standards and train others nationwide.

A father sought guidance after his 28-year-old son became defensive when offered career advice. Career coach Ruth Nemzoff, author of "Don't Bite Your Tongue," recommends three principles for advising adult children: know yourself and how your experiences filter your advice; know your child's individual communication style and current life circumstances; and know the specific economic and workplace environment they face. She suggests four techniques for positive discussions: ask if they want advice or just to vent; open with curious, non-judgmental questions; acknowledge their superior knowledge of their situation; and share your own career mistakes. Nemzoff advises helping children identify next steps rather than dictating solutions, suggesting third-party resources when appropriate, and accepting that they may not follow your advice.

Nike integrated sustainability into its core business through the "Considered" strategy, launched in 2005 and formalized under CR VP Hannah Jones and CEO Mark Parker in 2004. The approach shifted corporate responsibility from a compliance function to a design-driven, value-creating initiative measured by "ROI2"—financial and responsibility returns. The Considered Group developed tools like the Considered Index, a predictive scoring system launched in September 2007, to help designers make real-time environmental choices about materials, solvents, and waste during product development.

The Air Jordan XX3 (January 2008) was the first high-performance Considered product, using recycled content and minimized solvents. Nike committed to 100% of footwear meeting minimum Considered standards by Spring 2011. Core Performance, Nike's largest category, achieved Silver ratings across its entire line by Summer 2009 and produced the first Gold shoe, the Dual D Hoop, through a cross-functional task force that embedded sustainability into design briefs, performance reviews, and factory partnerships.

Implementation faced challenges: EPMs often cost more and sometimes compromised aesthetics or performance; design processes became more complex; time-pressed developers struggled to identify EPMs; margin pressures forced trade-offs; some factories lacked technical capacity for water-based bonding; and consumer willingness to pay for sustainability remained uncertain. Despite uneven uptake across categories, employee response was favorable, with visible CEO support driving cultural change. Competitors including Timberland, Adidas, and Brooks launched similar green initiatives during this period.

Swedish engineering group Sandvik reported first-quarter operating profit of 4.27 billion Swedish crowns, beating analyst forecasts of 4.00 billion, driven by strong performance in its metal-cutting tools business. However, weaker-than-expected results in its mining gear unit caused shares to fall 1.8 percent after an initial rise. Order intake reached 25.4 billion crowns, above the 24.6 billion forecast. CEO Björn Rosengren described the metal-cutting tools unit's performance as "uniquely strong" but acknowledged the mining unit needs improvement. Sandvik shares remain up more than 10 percent in 2018.

Future Market Insights projects the global bioprocessing analytics equipment market will grow at a 4.5% CAGR from 2018-2028. The market is segmented by product type (osmometers and bioprocess analysers, with osmometers leading), application (clinical and industrial, with industrial leading at 4.4% CAGR), and end user (biopharmaceutical companies being largest). North America dominates the market, while APECJ is projected to grow fastest at 5.9% CAGR. Technological advancements have led to integrated multi-functional analysers that reduce errors through automated sampling and feedback control.

This study investigates the adsorption of chlorothalonil (CLT), a toxic fungicide and carcinogen, on carbon nanotubes (CNTs) and boron nitride nanotubes (BNNTs) using density functional theory (DFT) and molecular dynamics simulations. CLT exhibits moderate physical adsorption on both nanotube types, with adsorption energies increasing as nanotube radius grows due to enhanced π-π stacking interactions on flatter surfaces. CNTs show stronger adsorption than BNNTs due to their greater polarizability (lower chemical hardness), facilitating more significant charge transfer. However, BNNTs demonstrate superior sensing capabilities: they exhibit shorter recovery times suitable for reversible sensing, and their band gaps are drastically reduced upon CLT adsorption (39-49% sensitivity) compared to minimal changes in CNTs (1-5%). BNNTs also show significant work function changes, unlike CNTs. Molecular dynamics simulations confirm thermal stability and preferential parallel orientation of CLT on both nanotube surfaces in aqueous solution. While both nanotubes can remove CLT from environments, BNNTs are better suited for detection applications due to their electronic sensitivity, though their work function response diminishes with increasing diameter.

Pneumonia and tuberculosis cause substantial global mortality, with misdiagnosis between them leading to treatment delays. Current AI-based diagnostic models using CNNs and deep learning have shown promise for chest X-ray analysis but lack critical capabilities: they fail to identify non-X-ray or anomalous cases and do not perform multi-class classification covering normal, pneumonia, TB, and non-X-ray categories simultaneously. Existing studies suffer from limitations including small or imbalanced datasets, computational inefficiency, poor generalizability across diverse populations, and inability to handle outliers. This study proposes a novel multi-class classification system using pretrained CNN models that categorizes chest X-rays into four classes—normal, pneumonia, tuberculosis, and non-X-ray—to enhance reliability and robustness for real-world clinical deployment.

Hounds of the Bay is a Canadian stock-picking strategy that selects the highest dividend-paying stocks from the S&P/TSX 60 index. Named after Toronto's Bay Street financial district, it resembles the Dogs of the Dow approach, operating on the premise that high dividend yields indicate companies near the bottom of their business cycle with potential for stock price growth. The strategy typically involves global commodity stocks, particularly in energy, causing it to underperform during events like the 2014 oil decline. Academic research suggests the strategy has worked historically, though its effectiveness has diminished in recent decades. Limited Canadian stock data restricts independent verification.

A coach discusses his team's performance in the finals, noting they need to improve in battle areas and puck possession. He mentions potential line adjustments, the need to be more tenacious while avoiding penalties, and praises a goalie's quiet demeanor. He describes goals given up as uncharacteristic and generous, noting third-period pressure was more effective. He emphasizes versatility in forward options, managing a player named Kaner, and being physical against Pronger. He praises Nicky's arrival and positioning, stresses avoiding critical late-period goals, and acknowledges tough lineup decisions with Burish and Laddy.

The smash concept is a widely used football passing play that creates big-play opportunities while allowing quick throws. It works well against man coverage, Cover 2, and Cover 4 by attacking the perimeter with corner routes and hitch routes. Against Cover 3, it risks interceptions if the quarterback throws late. The quarterback reads one side pre-snap based on defensive leverage, then "high-lows" the cornerback post-snap, throwing the hitch if the corner gains depth or the corner route if the corner plays low, with a running back checkdown as a safety valve. Two variations exist: one for 3x1 sets that adds a seam route and backside dig, and a sprint-out version that moves the pocket and includes a backside over route while allowing the quarterback to run.

The ISM Manufacturing Index (PMI) is a monthly economic indicator introduced in 1948 that assesses the health of the US manufacturing sector through a survey of purchasing managers. It measures production, new orders, employment, supplier deliveries, and inventories, with readings above 50 indicating expansion and below 50 indicating contraction. The index is calculated using weighted survey responses and is seasonally adjusted. While widely followed by investors, traders, and businesses for insights into economic direction and market impact, backtesting shows limited predictive value for stock market performance. The PMI is a backward-looking indicator, and markets often discount results before publication. It can inform trading strategies and be combined with other economic indicators, but is not a reliable standalone predictor for short-term trading or contrarian strategies.

Psychometrics is integrating NLP technologies to complement traditional questionnaire-based workflows, with applications ranging from AI Psychometrics to automated questionnaire item creation. The authors introduce "Survey and Questionnaire Item Embeddings Differentials" (SQuID), a method using LLM-generated semantic embeddings to replicate human rater judgments. They demonstrate this approach with the Revised Portrait Value Questionnaire (PVQ-RR), showing that SQuID-treated embeddings from general-purpose models can recover latent dimensions of social scientific questionnaires with performance matching human rater judgments. The method addresses a key limitation of prior embedding approaches—the inability to produce negative correlations—by subtracting a mean questionnaire embedding from individual item embeddings. Results show strong agreement between embedding-based and human-derived configurations, with congruence coefficients of 0.88 and 0.82 for the first two dimensions after Procrustes transformation. The authors position this as a complementary tool for psychometric research that is flexible, inexpensive, and scalable, while acknowledging limitations regarding measurement validity, potential training data contamination, and ethical concerns about crowdworker displacement.

The authors suggest that Task-4 performance could improve with a domain-specific pre-trained BERT model.

The Rate of Change (ROC) indicator, developed by Tom Demark, is a momentum-based technical oscillator that compares a security's current price to its price "n" periods ago. It is calculated as (Current Price – Price "n" periods ago) / Price "n" periods ago and plotted around a zero line, with positive values indicating upward momentum and negative values indicating downward momentum.

Traders use ROC to identify overbought/oversold conditions, centerline crossovers, divergences, and trend strength. Common strategies include mean reversion on oversold signals, breakouts, zero line crosses, and divergence-based reversals. However, backtesting shows ROC strategies generally underperform compared to alternatives like RSI, stochastic, and Williams %R.

ROC works best in trending markets with moderate volatility and is less effective in volatile or sideways markets due to whipsaws. The ideal lookback period varies by trading style—shorter periods (5-20 days) for short-term traders, longer periods (100-200 days) for long-term traders. ROC can be combined with trend-following indicators like moving averages to improve performance. Key limitations include vulnerability to false signals in volatile markets and the potential for prolonged overbought/oversold conditions.

This MIT lecture covers the Spring-Loaded Inverted Pendulum (SLIP) model for running dynamics. The SLIP model consists of a mass at the end of a spring-loaded leg with coordinates r (length) and theta (angle). Despite having a 4-D state space, the system can be reduced to a 1-D iterated map by examining apex heights, since horizontal position doesn't affect stability and horizontal velocity can be derived from energy conservation.

Comparative biomechanics research shows that diverse animals—from cockroaches to horses—exhibit similar non-dimensional dynamics when analyzed through the SLIP framework, despite vast differences in mass and kinematics. Animals use physical springs (tendons) for energy storage and efficiency.

The SLIP model assumes massless legs, ideal lossless springs, and elastic ground collisions. Using small-angle approximations, the stance phase yields a closed-form return map with stable and unstable fixed points. Stability emerges from piecewise holonomic coordinate transforms rather than energy dissipation.

Extensions include models with toe mass and energy injection via spring control. The SLIP template applies to both sagittal and lateral plane dynamics, explaining rapid perturbation recovery in cockroaches through "preflex" musculoskeletal responses. Raibert's hopping robots from the 1980s-90s demonstrated similar spring-mass behaviors, achieving robust running, jumping, and flipping. Recent "SLIP walkers" explore transitions between walking (vaulting) and running (bouncing) gaits, matching biological efficiency trade-offs.

This study evaluated the clinical relevance of circulating tumor cell (CTC) genomic variation in metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC). Researchers analyzed whole-exome sequencing data from CTC pools collected from 29 mCRC patients, measuring 15 genomic diversity metrics. Results showed that higher mutant allele tumor heterogeneity (MATH) scores and non-silent mutations in the BCL9L gene were significantly associated with poorer overall survival. Patients with high MATH scores had a median survival of 18.3 months versus 52.9 months for those with low scores, while BCL9L-mutated patients had a median survival of 14.5 months compared to 34.2 months for unmutated patients. A custom 55-gene panel (CRC-P55) produced MATH scores highly correlated with whole-exome sequencing results and similarly predicted survival outcomes, offering a cost-effective alternative for clinical use. This represents the first demonstration of an association between CTC genomic diversity and cancer outcomes in mCRC.

BerkeleyGW achieves exascale performance portability for quantum many-body materials simulations across AMD, Intel, and NVIDIA GPU architectures. The software delivers 1.069 ExaFLOP/s double-precision throughput on Frontier (59.45% of theoretical peak) and 707.52 PFLOP/s on Aurora (48.79% of attainable peak). Key innovations include GW perturbation theory for electron-phonon coupling, full-frequency GW with static subspace approximation, and a mixed stochastic-deterministic algorithm reducing O(N⁴) scaling. Optimized kernels using HIP, SYCL, and CUDA enable large-scale calculations of systems with 10³–10⁴ atoms, including silicon defects and twisted bilayer materials. OpenACC and OpenMP implementations provide portability, though hardware-optimized models achieve higher performance on non-NVIDIA systems.

The ASP Process of SFS involves six steps: checking DRAM address protection, verifying customer and AMD signatures, loading and running executable patches, updating patch level information, and returning status to the software agent. The ASP interface provides firmware and patch level information using two 4096-byte pages. The GET_SFS_VERSION_INFO command retrieves version data including API version (04h), current SFS and system patch levels, and firmware version entries containing version type enums, version numbers, and security patch levels. SFS packages are customer-maintained binary objects aligned to AGESA releases with specific naming conventions. Updates apply only when all validation completes, run parallel to x86/DMA traffic with minimal performance impact, and rarely require OS quiescing. SEV/SEV-ES VMs must stop/restart for firmware updates, while SEV-SNP VMs continue operation during updates.
